div.div: Groundedness over fluency: every claim traces to a source document span.
Determinism where money is involved: constraints and abstention are rule-based, never model-based.
Variant seam: rules engine and RAG engine share one pipeline behind two interfaces for fair A/B evaluation.
Reproducibility: runs fully offline; zero required API keys; pinned dependencies.

pre.code: Documents ──▶ Extractor ──▶ Normalizer ──▶ Validator ──▶ Storage (SQLite + Vector Index) │ NL Query ──▶ Query Parser ──▶ Retriever (BM25 + Dense + RRF)│ │ │ ▼ ▼ Ranker [rules | rag] ◀── Candidates │ ▼ Explainer [template | rag] ──▶ Recommendation (with evidence) │ ▼ Evaluator ──▶ P@5 / R@5 / Hit@5 + comparison report

tr.td: CLI entry: --query, --eval, --mode rules|rag; routes to pipeline
All thresholds, ranking weights, fusion params, model names — no magic numbers in code
Pydantic models: Opportunity, QueryIntent, RankedOpportunity, Recommendation — single source of truth
Rule/regex extraction of schema fields from raw text; missing stays None
Optional LLM extraction adapter behind same contract; system runs without it
₹/Rs/lakh/crore → INR ints; years/months/ranges → tenure_min/tenure_max
Pydantic validation; return-type classification (indicative/historical/coupon/variable)
SQLite persistence of validated records; rebuildable from documents
Offline build of BM25 index + embedding store (one command)
NL query → QueryIntent: budget, risk, tenure ± tolerance, free-text
Sparse retrieval — exact values, product names, numbers
Embedding cosine — paraphrases, intent language
RRF fusion of both rankings → top-k candidates
AbstractRanker interface — the seam
Hard-constraint filter → weighted score → abstain flag; weights justified in config
[VARIANT STUB] LLM reranking behind the same interface
AbstractExplainer interface — the seam
Reasons built from extracted fields + source spans; guarantee-language blocked
[VARIANT STUB] LLM draft + citation verifier behind same interface
Precision@5, Recall@5, HitRate@5
Runs labelled queries through both modes on identical retrieval
Per-query tables, overall scores, failure analysis, side-by-side comparison
Unit tests: normalization, extraction fidelity, abstention, metrics correctness
Architecture, assumptions, failure modes, 10M-doc scaling, production safeguards

div.div: Offline (once): documents → extraction → normalization → validation → SQLite → indexes.
Online (per query): parse → hybrid retrieve → rank → explain → (eval mode) score against labels.
AbstractRanker.rank(intent, candidates) -> list[RankedOpportunity] — must set abstain when unsupported.
AbstractExplainer.explain(intent, ranked) -> Recommendation — every reason carries claim + field + source doc + span.
System Design — Intelligent Financial Opportunity Analysis & Recommendation Engine
